title: IdentityTripleReprocessingRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the IdentityTripleReprocessingRequested event (class: domain), with which submission-svc asks canonical-svc to re-resolve the identity triple of one page of selected documents of one entity after a correction (INV-REQ-1006). The tenant travels in the CloudEvents envelope. The CloudEvents id of the event is the idempotency key of the consumer. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The entity whose identity triple was corrected; every document of the page belongs to this entity.

constitution.description: The constitution of the corrected identity triple.

effectiveFrom.description: The date from which the corrected identity triple takes effect.

changeRef.description: The reference of the confirmed change that the correction belongs to.

docUuids.description: The Doc UUIDs of the documents of this page, selected by submission-svc; a consumer reports a Doc UUID and never generates one.
